categories.title: IPs, domains and infrastructure
categories.blurb: Who is behind an address, what it has been caught doing, and whether it is hiding behind a proxy.

categories.title: Aircraft, ships and vehicles
categories.blurb: Live and historical movement of aircraft, vessels and vehicles.

categories.title: Conflict and live situation maps
categories.blurb: Front lines, strikes and events, mapped and kept current.

categories.title: Geolocation and imagery
categories.blurb: Pin down where and when a photo or video was taken.

categories.title: Image and video verification
categories.blurb: Reverse search, metadata and manipulation checks.

categories.title: People and accounts
categories.blurb: Usernames, email addresses and phone numbers across platforms.

categories.title: Companies, sanctions and crypto
categories.blurb: Ownership, officers, sanctions lists and money on chain.

categories.blurb: What a page said before someone changed or removed it.

categories.title: Methods and reference
categories.blurb: How-to guides and maintained indexes for when the tool you need is not listed here.

tools.name: VirusTotal
tools.note: Run a hash, file, URL, domain or IP past dozens of engines, then follow the relations graph to linked samples and infrastructure.

tools.name: MalwareBazaar
tools.note: abuse.ch's open malware repository. Search by hash, tag, signature or YARA rule and pull the sample for analysis.

tools.name: ANY.RUN
tools.note: Interactive sandbox: detonate a file or URL and click through it live while process, network and ATT&CK activity is recorded.

tools.name: Hybrid Analysis
tools.note: Free sandbox with detailed behavioural reports, plus a large searchable archive of other people's submissions.

tools.name: AbuseIPDB
tools.note: Community-reported abuse history for an IP address: who reported it, when, and for what, from brute forcing to port scanning.

tools.name: Scamalytics
tools.note: Fraud risk score for an IP address, flagging proxies, VPNs, Tor exits and datacentre ranges.

tools.name: Freedar
tools.note: UK community flight tracker built on ADS-B and MLAT feeds, showing military and private aircraft that commercial trackers often hide.

tools.name: DeepStateMap
tools.note: Daily-updated map of the front line in Ukraine, showing occupied ground, contested areas and recent advances.

tools.name: CyberChef
tools.note: GCHQ's browser toolkit for decoding, decompressing and converting almost anything: base64, gzip, XOR, hex and hundreds more, chained into recipes.

tools.name: urlscan.io
tools.note: Loads a URL in a sandbox and records screenshots, the DOM and every request, then lets you pivot on IPs, hashes and domains across historic scans.

tools.name: Shodan
tools.note: Internet-wide scan data: which services, banners and software versions an IP exposes, and every other host that matches.

tools.name: Censys
tools.note: Host and certificate search with deep service fingerprints; strong for tracking a server set-up across IPs.

tools.name: Validin
tools.note: Passive DNS and host-response history with a generous free tier; quick for following an actor's infrastructure over time.

tools.name: crt.sh
tools.note: Certificate Transparency search. Finds a domain's subdomains, and new look-alike domains the moment they get a certificate.

tools.name: GreyNoise
tools.note: Tells you whether an IP is background internet-wide scanning or something aimed at you.

tools.name: airplanes.live
tools.note: Community-run, unfiltered ADS-B map: military and blocked aircraft stay visible, with history playback.

tools.name: ADS-B Exchange
tools.note: The long-running unfiltered ADS-B network, with global coverage and track history.

tools.name: MarineTraffic
tools.note: Live AIS positions for ships worldwide, with vessel details and port calls.

tools.name: Global Fishing Watch
tools.note: AIS combined with satellite radar detections, so it shows vessels running dark with AIS switched off.

tools.name: DVLA vehicle enquiry
tools.note: Official UK check of a number plate: make, colour, tax and MOT status, first registration.

tools.name: MOT history
tools.note: Every MOT test for a UK vehicle, with mileage at each test and the faults found.

tools.name: Platesmania
tools.note: Crowd-sourced photos of number plates; useful for matching a vehicle to a place and time.

tools.name: GeoConfirmed
tools.note: Volunteer-geolocated footage from several conflicts, each pinned to the map with its source.

tools.name: Liveuamap
tools.note: Near-real-time incident map built from news and social media, covering many regions.

tools.name: NASA FIRMS
tools.note: Satellite thermal detections within hours of a pass; often the first confirmation of a strike or a large fire.

tools.name: GPSJam
tools.note: Daily map of GPS interference, worked out from what aircraft report.

tools.name: Oryx
tools.note: Lists of military equipment losses where every entry links to photo or video proof.

tools.name: ACLED
tools.note: Structured, coded data on political violence and protest worldwide. Free account needed for downloads.

tools.name: Copernicus Browser
tools.note: Free Sentinel satellite imagery with time-lapse and comparison, often only days old.

tools.name: Bellingcat OSM Search
tools.note: Finds places by a combination of features, such as a church near a railway line and a river.

tools.name: Overpass Turbo
tools.note: Write your own OpenStreetMap queries when a ready-made search is not precise enough.

tools.name: SunCalc
tools.note: Sun position and shadow direction for any place and time; the standard way to date a photo from its shadows.

tools.name: PeakVisor
tools.note: 3D terrain with named peaks; match a mountain skyline in a photo to where it was taken.

tools.name: Google Earth
tools.note: 3D imagery everywhere. Google Earth Pro on desktop adds historical imagery, often going back decades.

tools.name: InVID-WeVerify plugin
tools.note: Browser extension for verifying video and images: keyframes, reverse search, metadata and forensic filters.

tools.name: Yandex Images
tools.note: The strongest reverse image search for places, buildings and faces.

tools.name: TinEye
tools.note: Finds where else an image has appeared; sort by oldest to find the earliest copy.

tools.name: Google Lens
tools.note: General reverse image search; good on products, text and landmarks.

tools.name: Forensically
tools.note: Error level analysis, clone detection and noise analysis in the browser, to spot edited regions.

tools.name: ExifTool
tools.note: The reference tool for reading and writing file metadata: camera, GPS, timestamps, software.

tools.name: WhatsMyName
tools.note: Checks a username across hundreds of sites at once.

tools.name: Epieos
tools.note: What an email address or phone number is registered to, including linked Google accounts.

tools.name: OSINT Industries
tools.note: Email, phone or username lookups across a very wide range of services, with results in one report.

tools.name: Sherlock
tools.note: Command-line username search across hundreds of social networks.

tools.name: Companies House
tools.note: Official register of UK companies: officers, owners, filings and addresses, all searchable.

tools.name: OpenCorporates
tools.note: The largest open database of companies worldwide, across many jurisdictions.

tools.name: OCCRP Aleph
tools.note: Search across leaks, registries and investigative datasets gathered by OCCRP journalists.

tools.name: OpenSanctions
tools.note: Sanctions lists, politically exposed people and criminal watchlists merged into one search.

tools.name: Arkham
tools.note: Crypto analytics that labels who owns which wallets, and traces flows between them.

tools.name: mempool.space
tools.note: Open-source Bitcoin explorer for transactions, addresses and fees.

tools.name: Wayback Machine
tools.note: Snapshots of the web going back to 1996, plus Save Page Now to archive something before it changes.

tools.name: archive.today
tools.note: On-demand snapshots that often capture pages the Wayback Machine cannot, such as social media posts.

tools.name: Bellingcat Online Investigation Toolkit
tools.note: Bellingcat's maintained, annotated index of tools and how to use them, by investigation type.

tools.name: Triage
tools.note: Fast sandbox with strong malware family detection and config extraction: C2 addresses and keys pulled straight out of the sample.

tools.name: Malpedia
tools.note: Encyclopedia of malware families: aliases, the actors using them, YARA rules and curated reporting for each.

tools.name: ThreatFox
tools.note: abuse.ch's shared feed of indicators tied to named malware: C2 servers, payload URLs and hashes.

tools.name: URLhaus
tools.note: abuse.ch's database of URLs currently serving malware, with the payloads they drop.

tools.name: SecurityTrails
tools.note: Historical DNS and WHOIS: see what a domain pointed to before it moved, and what else shared its IP.

tools.name: RIPEstat
tools.note: Authoritative routing data for any IP or AS: who holds it, where it is announced, and how that has changed.

tools.name: Hurricane Electric BGP Toolkit
tools.note: Quick lookups for ASNs, prefixes and peers; the fastest way to see who owns a range and what else they announce.

tools.name: OpenSky Network
tools.note: Research-grade archive of ADS-B data; the place to go for historical flight tracks.

tools.name: Planespotters.net
tools.note: Airframe histories by registration or serial: operators, re-registrations and photos.

tools.name: Mapillary
tools.note: Crowd-sourced street-level imagery, often where Google Street View has never been.

tools.name: GeoHints
tools.note: Country-by-country visual clues: bollards, road markings, plates, poles and scripts.

tools.name: Have I Been Pwned
tools.note: Which known data breaches an email address appears in, and what was exposed.

tools.name: Intelligence X
tools.note: Search engine over leaks, pastes, the dark web and historical web data, by email, domain, IP or crypto address.

tools.name: TGStat
tools.note: Search and analytics for Telegram channels and posts, including mentions and forwards between channels.

tools.name: Etherscan
tools.note: The standard Ethereum explorer: transactions, tokens, contracts and labelled addresses.

tools.name: ICIJ Offshore Leaks
tools.note: Searchable entities and officers from the Panama, Paradise and Pandora Papers and other leaks.

tools.name: HM Land Registry
tools.note: Who owns a property in England and Wales; title registers cost a few pounds each.

tools.name: Ghostarchive
tools.note: Archives videos and pages that other archives struggle with, including YouTube and social media posts.
